mapper.select: SELECT c.class_name AS "className", ROUND(AVG(sc.score), 2) AS "avgScore", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/COUNT(*)*100, 2) AS "passRate", MAX(sc.score) AS "maxScore", MIN(sc.score) AS "minScore" FROM student s LEFT JOIN "class" c ON s.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN score sc ON s.stu_id = sc.stu_id GROUP BY c.class_name ORDER BY c.class_name
